Title: Carrier Marketplace — Post Truck
Description: POST /api/marketplace/trucks; drivers/fleets post available trucks (geo/time/equipment).

Title: Carrier Marketplace — Load Search
Description: GET /api/marketplace/loads/search with filters (lane,date,equipment,rate).

Title: Carrier Marketplace — Match/Bid
Description: POST /api/marketplace/match to express interest/bid on a load; status transitions.

Title: Carrier Marketplace — Chat Threads
Description: Create/list chat threads between poster and bidder; post messages; read receipts.

Title: App — Marketplace UI (Post/Search/Chat)
Description: Screens to post trucks, search loads, bid/match, and chat threads.
Depends On: Carrier Marketplace — Post Truck,Carrier Marketplace — Load Search,Carrier Marketplace — Chat Threads

Title: Claims — Create & Lifecycle
Description: POST /api/claims create incident/accident; statuses (open,in_review,submitted,paid,denied); timeline/audit.

Title: Claims — Docs Upload & Pack
Description: Attach images/docs; generate consolidated PDF pack.

Title: App — Claims UI
Description: Create claim, attach photos/docs, track status; generate/share pack.

Title: Driver Scorecards v2 — API
Description: GET scorecard by driver and rank endpoint; metrics: speeding/harsh/dwell/ontime; streaks/peer rank.

Title: App — Scorecards v2 UI
Description: Driver profile shows score, streaks, rank vs peers; badges.

Title: Billing — Metered Events
Description: POST /api/billing/meter; capture usage for features (ai_calls,route_opt,trihaul,ocr).

Title: Billing — Usage & Invoices
Description: GET /api/billing/usage?from&to; POST /api/billing/invoices/generate; RBAC org_admin only.

Title: App — Billing UI (Usage & Invoices)
Description: Admin view usage charts and invoices; link to PSP portal.

Title: Capacity Forecast — API
Description: GET /api/capacity/forecast?lane&horizon returns supply/demand index and confidence.

Title: App — Capacity Forecast UI
Description: Lane view shows supply vs demand index trend; callouts for tightening/loosening.

Title: Dynamic ETA Commitments — API
Description: POST /api/eta/commitment {load_id,appt_window} → commitment buffer and risk bands.

Title: App — Commitment UI
Description: Load detail shows commitment buffer, risk band; alert when at-risk.

Title: Fraud Graph Analytics — API
Description: POST /api/fraud/graph/score {subject} → risk with graph features (shared devices, emails, bank).

Title: App — Fraud Insights UI
Description: Vetting view shows graph-derived signals; reasons & links to related entities.

Title: Localization — i18n Messages
Description: GET /api/i18n/messages?locale; structure for client to fetch message bundles.

Title: Accessibility — Feedback & Audit
Description: POST /api/a11y/feedback and store audit tags (screen, wcag_issue).

Title: App — i18n & A11y Enhancements
Description: Wire locale switch; ensure large text/contrast; a11y feedback form.
